chunks: If both of you two (women) turn to God in penitence (it would be better). Your hearts have been impaired; and if you assist one another against him, then surely his helper is God, and Gabriel and the righteous believers, and, besides them, the angels are his helpers.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the two wives of the Prophet being addressed in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing Khadijah and Hafsa (or Aisha), highlighting the unique status of the Prophet’s household (Ahl al-Bayt) and the divine support (Tawfiq) granted to him against domestic discord. The mention of 'Gabriel and the righteous believers' underscores the continuity of revelation and communal solidarity, reinforcing the Prophet’s authority in both spiritual and social spheres.
